title: Worker-wrapper death before FIFO completion can stall the full-matrix scheduler
title_de: Worker-Wrapper-Abbruch vor FIFO-Completion kann den Full-Matrix-Scheduler blockieren
sink: Full-matrix worker-completion coordination; a missing FIFO token previously left the parent scheduler indefinitely blocked on read <&8.
observed_behavior: Before the local watchdog remediation, a worker wrapper killed after fake Make started but before emitting its FIFO completion token left the parent scheduler blocked indefinitely on read <&8. The wrapper could no longer report completion, while the parent had no bounded failure path for the missing token.
expected_behavior: A worker wrapper that dies before emitting its completion token causes a bounded scheduler failure rather than an indefinite wait. With VERIFIED_RUN_FULL_MATRIX_JOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=1, the runner exits 77 after the timeout. Once the child exits, the FD 9 full-matrix lock becomes reusable; this local behavior is fixed but awaits hosted-successor verification.
impact: A failed worker wrapper could indefinitely stall a full-matrix run, delay or prevent release evidence, and leave the scheduler unavailable to follow-up work. This is a validated P1 lifecycle/reliability release blocker, not a security finding.
preconditions: A full-matrix worker wrapper starts fake Make.
The wrapper is killed before emitting its FIFO completion token.
The parent scheduler waits for completion on read <&8.
reproduction: Start the focused worker-wrapper lifecycle control so fake Make has started.
Kill the worker wrapper before it emits its FIFO completion token.
Set VERIFIED_RUN_FULL_MATRIX_JOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=1 and observe the runner exit 77 rather than remain blocked on read <&8.
After the child exits, confirm that the FD 9 full-matrix lock is reusable.

evidence.retention_status: task_conversation_only; local remediation validated; hosted successor pending
evidence.result: Parent-confirmed: the focused test passed. It kills the wrapper after fake Make starts, the runner exits 77 with VERIFIED_RUN_FULL_MATRIX_JOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=1, and the FD 9 lock becomes reusable after child exit.

root_cause: The parent scheduler depended on a FIFO completion token from the worker wrapper. If the wrapper died after fake Make started but before token emission, read <&8 had no completion token and no bounded failure path, so the parent could wait indefinitely.
proposed_remediation: The local watchdog remediation bounds the missing-token wait and reports the controlled runner failure with exit 77. Retain the focused wrapper-death regression and FD 9 reuse control, then obtain fresh hosted-successor evidence before moving beyond fixed. No hosted verification, closure, or delivery disposition is claimed.
acceptance_criteria: When a worker wrapper dies after fake Make starts and before FIFO completion, the scheduler does not remain indefinitely blocked on read <&8.
With VERIFIED_RUN_FULL_MATRIX_JOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=1, the runner exits 77 through the bounded watchdog path.
After the child exits, the FD 9 full-matrix lock is reusable.
The focused worker-wrapper lifecycle regression passes.
Existing scheduler cap, port-plan, manifest, and result-policy controls remain effective.
Fresh hosted-successor evidence is obtained before verified or closed status.
validation_plan: Retain an exact local receipt for tests.test_full_matrix_parallel_scheduler.test_scheduler_times_out_when_a_job_wrapper_dies_before_completion, including the fake-Make start, wrapper death, timeout, exit 77, and FD 9 reuse assertions.
Run the applicable combined scheduler controls and preserve cap, port-plan, manifest, result-policy, and FD 9 lock behavior.
Obtain fresh hosted-successor full-matrix and protected-integration evidence before verified or closed status.
legitimate_control_tests: Fake Make starts before the wrapper-death injection.
The runner exits 77 after VERIFIED_RUN_FULL_MATRIX_JOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=1 rather than hanging on read <&8.
The FD 9 lock is reusable only after child exit.
Concurrent scheduler cap, port allocation, manifest publication, and result-policy controls remain intact.
dependencies: Local watchdog remediation in the Parent full-matrix scheduler
residual_risk: The watchdog remediation and focused local control are parent-confirmed task-conversation evidence only; no retained filesystem receipt or hosted-successor result has been supplied. The finding is fixed locally, not verified or closed, and remains a P1 release blocker until the required hosted-successor evidence exists.

Das Finding ist lokal fixed, nicht verified oder closed, und bleibt ein P1-Release-Blocker, bis die erforderliche Hosted-Successor-Evidence vorliegt.

history.detail: Parent-confirmed focused local regression proves bounded exit 77 and FD 9 reuse after wrapper death before FIFO completion. The finding is fixed locally only; no hosted verification, closure, or delivery disposition is claimed.
